chunk_map.heading: It runs without you until Day 2

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 'The digest agent runs while the team is away' is the closest: 'digest agent' and 'the team' are definite nouns not introduced earlier in this one-chunk file; both are the training's arc vocabulary and 'it' (L4, L6) binds to 'The digest agent' in-chunk. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent; host-deck fit belongs to the sequence judges.
L6 'Day 2 opens on what it wrote.' names a day of the training, not another file by position. No 'the opening lecture' style callback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 'last week's tickets, interviews and analytics' is closest; it names inputs, not a beat 'you did/saw/caught'. No backward beat reference exists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no demo or guess beat on slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 'Day 2 opens on what it wrote.' is the thinnest line but L4 carries a self-contained claim (agent reads inputs, leaves digest by morning).
L1 header 'It runs without you until Day 2' vs L4 'runs while the team is away ... ready by morning' and L6 'Day 2 opens on what it wrote': header literally true, no contradiction.
L4 'only what the team agreed may go in' is nearest a tic but is one declarative; no not-X-not-Y, triple, superlative, number+retraction, abstraction stack or empty verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Read all 7 body lines for firing/compendium/forcing function/beat/mood/surface -> none. 'digest agent' is training product vocabulary, not maintainer dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body lines 1-7 contain no bold markers (grep -c '\*\*' on body = 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file; presence in host deck is the host file's property

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 '## It runs without you until Day 2' is a declarative claim, fitting a lecture-type slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 'Day 2 opens on what it wrote.' is the nearest to a kicker but points forward to Day 2's work rather than restating the header; adds a move.
